candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Bioelectric networks review and cited historical source

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Bioelectric networks review and cited Xenobot materials

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Bioelectric networks review and cited craniofacial study

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Bioelectric networks review and cited ectopic-organ studies

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Bioelectric networks review

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots supporting materials

operationalization: Compare the frequency and functional diversity of novel self-assembled forms across unedited adult human and amphibian embryonic cells under defined environments.

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots supporting materials

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots supporting materials

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots supporting materials

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots supporting information

operationalization: Compare size distributions and bidaily motile fractions among 15000, 30000, and 60000 cells/mL cultures using a prespecified density-by-time model.

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots supporting information
candidate_datasets.role: public density-condition size and motility measurements

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots supporting materials

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots supporting information

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots videos and code

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots videos and code

candidate_datasets.name: PubMed Central: Motile Living Biobots morphology materials
